messages:
deploy-bot: kicking off config-only deploy: routing-default=v3, request-timeout: 2s -> 1.8s, tenant tiny-batch.window=15ms -> 8ms. Canary: 3 hosts in us-east. Command: /deploy config-only --canary --note="tighten-routing-and-tinybatch"

michael_eng: change window? any tenant pins?

janet_pm: change window 18:30-19:30 UTC. Goal: reduce tail latency on short queries and lower per-token cost for bursty microflows. Pin request: healthcare-tenant must remain on routing:v2 (regulatory).

michael_eng: will add tenant-exclude rule before ramp. Rolling checklist: canary 10m -> 10% 20m -> 30% 30m. Rollback if p99 > +12% or 5xx > +0.25% over baseline.

deploy-bot: Canary applied: hosts=3/3, health=passing, metrics-stream hooked.

rachel_sre: FYI autoscaler in us-east set to conservative, I'll flip to aggressive for 40m. Watch host CPU and GC pauses.

tara_ops: subscribed to perf, errors, and infra channels. I'll monitor request_5xx_rate and queue_depth.

michael_eng: pushed tenant rule: /rules add --tenant=healthcare-tenant --policy=routing:v2 --note="regulatory pin pre-deploy"

deploy-bot: Rule added id=rule_9912

rachel_sre: canary 8m in: p50/p95 flat, p99 down 4% for short flows. No 5xx. Proceed to 10% ramp.

deploy-bot: ramping traffic 0.00 -> 0.10 over 4m. Observability auto-guards enabled.

michael_eng: logs show tiny-batch window tightened to ~8-9ms as expected. Host throughput slightly increased.

rachel_sre: 14m into 10% ramp: seeing memory pressure on subset of hosts (model_pool_b: host-209, host-210) — resident memory rising ~18%. Some request latencies climb. 5xx on router at 0.22% (baseline 0.05%).

janet_pm: are errors tenant-scoped?

rachel_sre: not healthcare-tenant. Mostly from small-chatcohort users routed through model_pool_b. Traces: a3b1, a3b2. Suspect quantized kernel path combined with smaller timeout causing retries.

michael_eng: immediate mitigations: (1) pause ramp and drop weight to 6% (from 10%), (2) increase tiny-batch.window back to 10ms for model_pool_b hosts, (3) add host-specific routing fallback to routing:v2-old. Applying now.

deploy-bot: Traffic adjusted to 6%. Applying host overrides: host-209, host-210 pinned fallback=routing:v2-old.

rachel_sre: after adjustments: 5xx down to 0.07%, p99 trending toward baseline. Memory growth stabilized. Nice work.

janet_pm: capture this in release notes: mention soft host fallback and temporary batch-window tweak. Also create follow-up: investigate quantized-kernel compatibility with routing=v3 for model_pool_b.

michael_eng: adding rollout guard proposal to PR: 
```
rollout: {
  auto_guard: true,
  error_threshold_pct: 0.25,
  weight_decrease_step: 40,
  host_override_on_error: true
}
```

janet_pm: add an alert: page if cluster 5xx > 0.5% for 10m. Also record ticket INC-1102 for pool_b investigation.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused at 6% traffic. Hosts healthy. Tenant healthcare-tenant remains pinned to routing:v2. Actions logged: PR-4998 (guard change), INC-1102 (model_pool_b follow-up).

michael_eng: I'll update release notes and schedule follow-up for next sprint. Plan to re-run a narrow canary with adjusted batch windows before resuming full ramp.

tara_ops: I'll keep monitoring for 45m. Resume or full rollback decision after that window. :thumbsup:
